preconditions.description: The array length n must be between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All elements in the array must be positive integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any(all(x == target for x in array) for target in possible_targets) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if there exists a target value such that all elements can be made equal to it in at most n operations, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(len(operations) <= n for operations in possible_operation_sequences) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the number of operations m must be at most n, and each operation must consist of three distinct indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(i) <= n and 1 <= int(j) <= n and 1 <= int(k) <= n and i != j and j != k and k != i for line in operations_lines for i, j, k in [line.split()]) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: Each operation must consist of three distinct indices within the valid range of the array.
